name: test-prep-signup
description: Registration & login workflow for a high-school test-prep questionnaire app (free mode only)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n functions,client -c blue,magenta "wrangler pages dev client/dist --compatibility-flags=nodejs_compat --port=8788" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy client/dist
